wd.closed: Also show completed withdrawals (paid or rejected)

chip.newDays: {pct}% of earnings come from accounts less than {days} days old
chip.newRecent: {pct}% of earnings come from recent accounts
chip.refundedBuyers: Buyers with a Stripe refund or dispute: {pct}% of earnings
chip.banned: Creator's account banned: no transfer will be sent
chip.deleted: Creator's account deleted: no transfer will be sent

lastError.insufficient_stripe_balance: Not enough available Stripe balance: the withdrawal stays approved, try again when the funds are available.
lastError.insufficient_platform_funds: Safeguard: the net money collected does not cover this withdrawal.
lastError.account_not_ready: The creator's payout account is not ready.

err.insufficient_stripe_balance: Not enough available Stripe balance ({available} available, {needed} needed). The withdrawal stays approved: try again when the funds are available.
err.account_not_ready: The creator's payout account is not ready ({status}).
err.transfer_mismatch: Stripe returned a transfer that does not match the request (amount or destination): it is NOT marked as paid. Check the transfer in Stripe, then click “Check with Stripe”.
err.stripe_uncertain: Stripe answered in a way that does not allow a conclusion{code}: the transfer result is uncertain. Click “Check with Stripe” before trying again.
err.stripe_failed: Stripe declined the transfer{code}. The withdrawal is marked as failed and can be retried; there is no double debit.
err.stripe_noanswer: Stripe did not respond{code}: nothing was declined or paid, the withdrawal stays approved. Try again in a few minutes.
err.account_disabled: The creator's account is {why}: the transfer was not sent. If you reject the request, their credits are returned to them.
err.country_not_allowed: The country of the payout account{country} is no longer in the list of accepted countries: the transfer was not sent. Add it back to the accepted countries in the platform settings, or reject the request.
err.stripe_unreachable: Stripe did not respond: the result is uncertain. Click “Check with Stripe” before trying again.
err.paid_but_db_update_failed: The transfer was sent ({id}) but saving it failed: click “Check with Stripe”, do not reject.
err.in_progress: This withdrawal is already being processed.
err.request_rejected: This request has already been rejected.
err.legacy_request: Old request (before Stripe): reject it, the credits are returned to the creator.
err.withdrawals_disabled: Withdrawals are suspended: they are turned off in the platform settings.
err.invalid_state: This request is no longer in a state that allows this action. The list will be refreshed.
err.session: Session expired: sign in again, then try again.
err.stripe_not_configured: Payments are not set up yet: the withdrawal service is missing its Stripe secret key.
err.service_unavailable: The payment service is temporarily unavailable. No transfer was sent by this request: try again in a few minutes.
err.not_found: Request not found: the list will be refreshed.
err.internal_error: Internal error in the withdrawal service: try again, then check the server logs if it keeps happening.
err.network: Connection failed. Check your internet connection, then try again.

resume.hint: Use only if the transfer stays “in progress” {wait}: before that delay the server refuses to resume, because another process may still be sending the money.

check.anomaly: ANOMALY: a Stripe transfer{transfer} exists for this request although it is “{label}”. The creator received the money AND keeps their credits. Nothing was changed: cancel the transfer in the Stripe dashboard or remove their credits, then check their account.
check.found: Transfer found in Stripe: the withdrawal is marked as paid, no second transfer was created.
check.none: No transfer in Stripe for this withdrawal: you can send the transfer again without risk of a duplicate.
check.pending: No transfer found in Stripe for now (status: {label}). If the withdrawal stays “in progress”, wait a few minutes, then use “Resume the transfer”.

wd.platform: Creator portal · Available for withdrawals: {available}{inflight}. The available Stripe balance is checked when the transfer is made.
wd.uncertain: Transfer result uncertain: check with Stripe before trying again.
wd.payAllConfirm: Approve and pay out {n} {unit} without alerts, for a total of {total}?
wd.approveConfirm: Approve this withdrawal? {amount} will be transferred to the Stripe account of {email}.
wd.adopted: A transfer already existed in Stripe for this withdrawal: it was linked, and no second transfer was created.
wd.uncertainReject: The transfer result is uncertain: click “Check with Stripe” first.
wd.alreadyDone: This request has already been processed. The list will be refreshed.

rf.confirm: Confirm the refund? The credits will be returned to the buyer and taken back from the seller.
